cohort: The study participants were pregnant women admitted with fever to a tertiary referral centre in South India between January 2015 and December 2018.
finding: Pregnant women diagnosed with dengue infection during pregnancy experienced increased rates of adverse maternal outcomes (maternal deaths, thrombocytopenia) and perinatal outcomes (stillbirth, preterm birth, low birth weight) compared to those without dengue.
cross-section timing: Data collected retrospectively from January 2015 to December 2018.
